subject: Trial momentum brief & action anchors
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@brightlinehealth.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Trial momentum brief & action anchors

Hi Elena / Mark —

Great to meet yesterday. Quick recap and proposed anchors to keep the trial moving at the velocity we discussed. I kept this focused so your team can pick owners quickly.

High-level goal
- Prove 2x improvement in customer support triage time on the selected dataset (3-week window).

Success criteria (measurable)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation time < 300ms for 1K-token requests
- Accuracy proxy: intent match rate >= 88% vs. your current rule-based baseline
- Cost: token cost <= $0.0025 per response at current volume (with caching profiles applied)

Evaluation plan (owners & timeline)
- Week 0 (this week): data snapshot + access for Redwood runtime (owner: Mark) — due Wed 6/23
- Week 1: model selection + smoke tests (owner: Jordan) — due Mon 6/28
- Week 2: focused evaluation (A/B vs baseline) + QA (owner: Marissa) — due Mon 7/5
- Week 3: readout + decision checklist (owner: Elena) — readout Wed 7/7

Immediate asks (48–72h)
1) Provide S3 snapshot or secure share of the 5k sample tickets and the schema we discussed (owner: Mark) — target: 6/23
2) Confirm network egress policy and whether we should submit an IP allowlist request (owner: Mark) — target: 6/24
3) Nominate one technical contact for day-to-day (suggested: Mark) and one business sponsor (suggested: Elena)

Attachments: I attached a short success-metrics workbook and a network requirements PDF to buffer your infra team.

Proposed kickoff: Thurs 6/24 10:00–10:30 PT (30m) — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks — happy to tighten any of the criteria if you want different thresholds.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: trial_success_metrics.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)]
[Attachment: network_requirements.pdf (pdf, 52KB)]

From: Elena Ortiz <elena@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial momentum brief & action anchors

Thanks Jordan — this is helpful and exactly the structure we wanted. A couple quick clarifications:

- The sample set: we can share a redacted S3 snapshot (PII removed). Mark will coordinate with infra.
- Network: we prefer an IP allowlist; I’ll ask our security lead to review your network_requirements.pdf and come back with comments by EOD 6/23.
- KPI tweak: instead of 2x improvement in triage time, can we make the objective a relative reduction of 35% (that’s what procurement will benchmark)? If you can reflect that in the metric workbook, helpful.

Mark — can you own the S3 snapshot delivery and reach out to Jordan for credentials?

We’re good for the 6/24 kickoff at 10:00 PT pending the calendar invite.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Product, Brightline Health
elena@brightlinehealth.com | +1 617-555-3387

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@brightlinehealth.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial momentum brief & action anchors

Elena — perfect, thanks for the quick read. 35% reduction is fine; I updated the worksheet to include both absolute and relative targets (attached version v1.1).

Mark — if you share the S3 path and a short IAM role/keys note, Monica will validate access on our side and Marissa will start the smoke tests as soon as we get data. Also, if your security lead prefers a signed MOU for a short window of access, we can do that (we often use a simple one-week scoped access doc).

I’ll send the kickoff invite for 6/24 10:00 PT. Agenda: introductions, data handoff checklist, scope of queries, and next-steps calendar.

Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: trial_success_metrics_v1.1.xlsx (xlsx, 30KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Trial momentum brief & action anchors

Looping in as promised — I’ll lead the evaluation plan (Week 2 deep-dive and A/B run). Monica, let’s sync Tuesday 6/22 11:00 PT to confirm the smoke-tests checklist and any infra blockers.

Quick notes for our side:
- Smoke tests: sample scoring, latency profiling, and a small A/B candidate set (1000 tickets)
- Access checklist: S3 read permissions, temporary credentials or presigned URLs preferred

Elena/Mark — if you have a preferred slack channel for day-to-day, send it over and we’ll join.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
